group_manifest.proof_strategy: First prove suffixed functional/bound helpers in the group-local case_lib. Normalize Empty/Divide result codes and unsigned32 expressions. Establish actual=min(requested,available), positive/bounded copy lengths, and wrap/non-wrap inequalities. Then use UCharArray full/seg split rules together with sublist_split and Zlength_sublist to expose the exact source/destination segments required by each memcpy entailment. The partial_solve witnesses reuse the same pure bounds and list side conditions.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: forall readidx writeidx area_length b_status x y, CircularAreaDataLengthResult readidx writeidx area_length b_status x -> CircularAreaDataLengthResult readidx writeidx area_length b_status y -> x = y

premises.premise: two CircularAreaDataLengthResult facts for identical state
premises.arithmetic: mixed full/non-full branches are contradictory; same branches give identical results

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: forall readidx writeidx area_length b_status contents n, CircularAreaDescriptorState readidx writeidx area_length b_status contents -> CircularAreaDataLengthResult readidx writeidx area_length b_status n -> 0 <= n <= area_length

premises.arithmetic: full result is area_length; non-full result is nonnegative remainder below positive modulus

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: forall state requested actual, 0 <= requested -> CircularAreaDescriptorState ... -> CircularAreaActualReadLength ... requested actual -> 0 <= actual <= requested /\ actual <= area_length
